explication: osu! wiki is a documentation repository whose principal workflow is: a reader visits the osu! wiki, finds an article by topic, and consumes guidance or reference content. The repository is organized into beatmap, gameplay, client, community, and editorial domains, with news and contests as additional content branches. The tree and README establish the content repository and published wiki relationship, but no site-rendering or deployment source was sampled; those edges are therefore limited to documented publication and reading behavior.
